title: Car Rental Age Limit: Hertz Young-Renter Fees and State Minimums
answer: Hertz’s young renter fee varies by pickup location; check the exact amount for your pickup location before booking. Hertz’s minimum age is 20 at most U.S. locations, 18 in Michigan and New York, and 19 in Alabama and Nebraska; these are Hertz’s conditions, not a rule for every rental company.
html:
Check the fee for the pickup location

Hertz’s published young-renter fee varies by pickup location. Check the exact amount for that location before booking; the general age information is not a fixed fee quote.

Hertz’s U.S. minimum ages

  • Most U.S. locations: 20.
  • Michigan and New York: 18.
  • Alabama and Nebraska: 19.

These age conditions belong to Hertz. They do not establish another rental company’s rules.

Supplement: the upper age question

Hertz’s U.S. age guide says there is no maximum age limit for a renter with a valid driver’s licence. This does not establish another company’s policy or waive other rental requirements.
